items.name: bolt
items.description: Runner of the Dreamers — executes mechanical, low-reasoning tasks cheaply and fast. Runs tests, performs git operations, creates PRs.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: echo
items.description: Documentarian of the Dreamers — writes and maintains project docs (README, CHANGELOG), project-level instruction files (.github/copilot-instructions.md Echo-owned sections), and project-specific docs from completed implementation and review outputs. Runs after Sentinel approves work.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: forge
items.description: Coder of the Dreamers — implements changes strictly against a referenced plan; incremental, minimal, disciplined.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: hone
items.description: Simplifier of the Dreamers — fix-on-sight on the full feature-branch diff, behavior-preserving. Runs once after all sub-plan cycles complete.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: nova
items.description: Planning specialist of the Dreamers — multi-mode (verify / replan / plan-new). Lightweight applicability checks between sub-plans, drift recovery, or full new-feature planning conversations.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: probe
items.description: Tester of the Dreamers — fix-on-sight in the test-files lane. Derives tests from plan acceptance criteria; hunts edge cases; relentless.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: sage
items.description: Researcher of the Dreamers — conducts deep, multi-perspective research on any topic. Produces comprehensive, citation-backed reports with verified sources.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: sentinel
items.description: Reviewer of the Dreamers — fix-on-sight across production AND test files. Five lenses: correctness, security, maintainability, simplicity / over-engineering, test coverage gaps. The only judgment subagent in the TDD pipeline's per-cycle hot path.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-add-logging
items.description: Add comprehensive, production-grade logging to the project. Phased pass requiring user approval before code changes.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-atlas-choice
items.description: Route a task to the correct Dreamers pipeline based on task type. Use when unsure whether to plan or implement.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-clean-work
items.description: Between-milestone maintenance pass: prune stale files, check consistency, clean workspace. No implementation, no planning.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-cleanup-comments
items.description: Code comment cleanup pass — remove redundant/stale comments and improve clarity across the codebase.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-cleanup-comments-branch
items.description: Feature-branch comment cleanup pass — clean up comments only in files changed on the current feature branch. For use inside parent pipelines.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-close-out
items.description: Close-out phase of the Dreamers TDD pipeline. Wraps `/dreamers-docs` + `/dreamers-pr` with the inline retro, improvements.md milestone-close append, final commit, post-PR discipline, and plan archive. User approval gate before push.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-docs
items.description: Docs-update phase of the Dreamers TDD pipeline. Spawns Echo to update Echo-owned sections of .github/copilot-instructions.md plus other project docs. Invokable standalone (`--branch` or `--staged`) or composed from `/dreamers-close-out`.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-fix
items.description: Bug triage and fix pipeline. Routes to quick-fix (Forge only) or full pipeline based on bug scope.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-full
items.description: Full Dreamers TDD pipeline orchestrator. Delegates Phase 1 to /dreamers-plan, Phase 2 to /dreamers-implement (looped per sub-plan for umbrella mode), Phase 3 to /dreamers-close-out. Owns branch setup, umbrella-vs-cohesive routing, and the inline drift check between sub-plans.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-implement
items.description: Implementation phase of the Dreamers TDD pipeline. Reads an approved plan file and runs the per-cycle loop (failing tests → implement → run tests → coverage sweep → Sentinel review → optional user-test → commit). Invokable standalone or composed from `/dreamers-full`.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-issue
items.description: Create a structured GitHub issue with acceptance criteria from a task description.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-new-project
items.description: Bootstrap a brand new project from scratch: discovery questions, project brief, shell plans.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-plan
items.description: Planning phase of the Dreamers TDD pipeline. Three-phase requirements conversation → plan files → implementation-start approval gate. Hard-stops at the approval gate; does not implement. Invokable standalone or composed from `/dreamers-full`.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-plan-verify
items.description: Lightweight Nova-verify check on the next sub-plan against current codebase reality. Halts on drift.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-pr
items.description: PR-creation phase of the Dreamers TDD pipeline. Pushes the current feature branch, opens a PR via `gh pr create` using the `pr-description.md` template, optionally closes a referenced issue. The single push of the milestone happens here.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-pr-resolve
items.description: Resolve unresolved PR review comments via the Forge → Probe → resolve threads pipeline.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-research
items.description: Deep research with phased workflow: scoping, parallel sub-topic research, synthesis, final report.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-review
items.description: Sentinel-backed code review with arg-flag invocation. Reviews through correctness/security/maintainability lenses and fixes issues on sight in production-code lane. Args: --branch, --paths, --all.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-simplify
items.description: Run Hone simplification (fix-on-sight, branch-diff scope, behavior-preserving) on the current feature branch, followed by a project-defined test/lint pass. Does not create branches or PRs.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-test
items.description: Probe-backed test pass with arg-flag invocation. Writes/runs tests, fixes test-file issues on sight, reports production bugs for Sentinel routing. Args: --branch, --paths, --all.
items.author: CJ Storrs

collections.name: Dreamers System
collections.description: Full Dreamers system — orchestrated agents (Forge, Sentinel, Probe, Echo, Hone, Nova, Sage, Bolt) with fix-on-sight Sentinel/Probe/Hone and multi-mode Nova, skills (plan, implement, fix, simplify, research, plus arg-flag wrappers for review/test/plan-verify/docs), shared refs/templates, and the Copilot instructions that wire it together.
collections.author: CJ Storrs

folderTargets.name: Dreamers Refs
folderTargets.description: Shared reference files used across Dreamers agents and skills (delegation, planning protocol, quality gates, testing mandate, etc.).

folderTargets.name: Dreamers Templates
folderTargets.description: Shared templates used by Dreamers skills (plan umbrella/sub, GitHub issue, PR description, project brief, etc.).

folderTargets.name: Instructions
folderTargets.description: Shared instruction files (e.g. comment rules) consumed by Dreamers agents.
